narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month} a close friend came asking, and you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month the lives first parted on {first_bar_apart}, the measure of how long each could last with nothing coming in. In month {layoff_month} the layoff reached both, and the ghost closed it with a net worth {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost's money stood {net_worth_gap}. Its room to ride out a stretch without pay sat {safety_gap}.
